mapper.insert: INSERT INTO career_profile (profile_id, current_position, total_work_years, career_directions, industries, education_experiences, work_experiences, project_experiences, skills, certificates, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{currentPosition}, #{totalWorkYears}, #{careerDirections}, #{industries}, #{educationExperiences}, #{workExperiences}, #{projectExperiences}, #{skills}, #{certificates}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE career_profile SET current_position = #{currentPosition}, total_work_years = #{totalWorkYears}, career_directions = #{careerDirections}, industries = #{industries}, education_experiences = #{educationExperiences}, work_experiences = #{workExperiences}, project_experiences = #{projectExperiences}, skills = #{skills}, certificates = #{certificates}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}
